Trust & Security

Certifications

  • SOC 2 Type II
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27018
  • HIPAA: BAA available on Enterprise Grid plans

Loop Assist and AI

Loop Assist provides summarization and drafting inside the workspace.

  • Training: Loop does not use customer content to train its AI models.
  • Model hosting: Assist inference runs on infrastructure operated by Loop's cloud provider within Loop's virtual private cloud. Model weights are licensed from a third party; the provider is named on our subprocessor page.
  • Autonomy: Assist produces drafts and summaries only. A human sends every message.
  • Logging: Assist usage events are available in the Enterprise audit log export.
  • Retention: Prompts and generated outputs are retained for 30 days for abuse monitoring, then deleted.

Data Residency

Enterprise Grid customers may pin data at rest to the US, EU, or Australia. AI inference for pinned workspaces occurs in the pinned region.

Incident Response

Loop notifies customers of confirmed security incidents affecting their data within 72 hours. Loop does not currently publish a separate AI-specific incident process.
